note: The Wilson curve with coupling beta, zero vacuum scalar and density exp(-beta E^W) over B_N is the begins/initial field, proved for the constructed datum through Factor.worksNow; it is a field of a structure for an existentially chosen construction rather than a standalone theorem, and I_{N,p} is Lives plus the recipe's first predicate.

structure Program (B : Directed G I Z K P) : Prop where
  begins N p : ∃ F, Curve (B.a.budget N) (n:=B.a.S.side N p) F (band B.a N) ∧
      ∀ β∈band B.a N,(F β).beta=β ∧ Lives B.bake N N p (F β) ∧ B.bake.Starter N p (F β)
  advances N p (m : ℕ) : m < N →
    ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → ∀ Q, Curve (B.a.budget (m+1)) Q (Set.Icc l u) →
      (∀ x∈ Set.Icc l u, Lives B.bake N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta ∈ band B.a (m+1)) →
      ∃ T, Curve (B.a.budget m) T (Set.Icc l u) ∧
        ∀ x∈ Set.Icc l u,B.Move N m p (T x) (Q x)

structure Issues (N p) : Prop where
  initial : ∃ F, Curve (a.budget N) (n:=a.S.side N p) F (band a N) ∧
      ∀ β∈band a N,(F β).beta=β ∧ Lives R N N p (F β) ∧ R.Starter N p (F β)
  advances (m : ℕ) : m < N →
    ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → ∀ Q, Curve (a.budget (m+1)) Q (Icc l u) →
      (∀ x∈ Icc l u, Lives R N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta ∈ band a (m+1)) →
      ∃ T, Curve (a.budget m) T (Icc l u) ∧
        ∀ x∈ Icc l u,Lives R N m p (T x) ∧ R.Relays N m p (T x) (Q x)

structure Starter (N p) (u : Rep G (a.S.side N p)) : Prop where
  scalars : u.v=0
  raw : u.eval=bare u.beta
  inits : R.first N p u
